fields.description: Optimus is Tesla's humanoid robot program. Tesla's April 2026 investor update says preparations for the first large-scale Optimus factory begin shortly in Q2 2026. The first-generation line, designed for 1 million robots a year, will replace the Model S and Model X lines in Fremont; Gigafactory Texas is being prepared for a second-generation line designed for long-term annual production capacity of 10 million robots. The factory-capacity table lists Optimus facilities in California and Texas with construction status. Tesla describes progress ahead of mass production, but the update publishes no price, mass, payload, speed, battery runtime, delivered fleet or independent performance result.

fields.description: Misty II is Misty Robotics' programmable social robot for education and research. Manufacturer documentation lists a 35.56 cm height, 25.4 cm depth, 20.32 cm width and 2.7 kg mass, Qualcomm Snapdragon 820 and 410 processors, an Occipital Structure Core depth sensor, a 4K camera, Snapdragon neural processing, eight IR time-of-flight sensors, ten bump sensors, a 4-inch LCD and a patent-pending 3-degree-of-freedom neck with customizable moving arms. The tracked drive has a trailer hitch, and the hazard system detects drops of 60 mm or more and limits speed to about 450 mm/s. USB/UART expansion and an optional Arduino-compatible backpack support external hardware. The docs publish no battery runtime, payload rating, IP rating or current availability.

highlights: Depth camera, time-of-flight sensors and bump sensors support environment perception
A three-axis neck, moving arms, tracked drive and LCD support physical interaction
Local Wi-Fi APIs and USB/serial expansion support programmable skills and external hardware
Manufacturer documentation lists Misty II at 35.56 cm height, 25.4 cm depth, 20.32 cm width and 2.7 kg mass.
The robot uses Qualcomm Snapdragon 820 and 410 processors, an Occipital Structure Core depth sensor, a 4K camera and Snapdragon neural processing for face and object recognition.
A patent-pending 3-degree-of-freedom neck, customizable moving arms, tracked drive and a trailer hitch support physical interaction and payload pulling.
The hazard system uses eight IR time-of-flight sensors and ten bump sensors, detects drops of 60 mm or more and limits maximum speed to about 450 mm/s.
USB/UART expansion and an optional Arduino-compatible backpack support external hardware. No battery runtime, payload rating or IP rating is published.

fields.description: ElliQ is Intuition Robotics' AI care companion for older adults. The manufacturer describes a stationary device with an integrated screen, proactive conversation, shared activities and a Relationship Orchestrator that combines multiple LLMs with context, memory, goals and real-time guardrails. The January 9, 2024 announcement identifies ElliQ 3 as a lighter hardware generation with a 36% smaller footprint, a fully integrated screen and a MediaTek octa-core plus AI chip SoC. It says the generative-AI software upgrade is compatible with all ElliQ hardware versions, while ElliQ 3 hardware was expected in spring 2024. The company reports loneliness, health and social-connection outcomes and describes a leased membership service; the reviewed pages publish no numeric price, mass, dimensions, battery runtime or independent clinical certification.

companyFocus.name: Tesla
companyFocus.role: Electric vehicle, energy and humanoid robot manufacturer
highlights: Tesla's April 2026 investor update says it is preparing the first large-scale Optimus factory in Q2, with a first-generation line designed for 1 million robots a year.
The first-generation line is to replace Model S and Model X lines in Fremont; Texas is being prepared for a second-generation line with long-term annual capacity of 10 million robots.
The factory-capacity table lists Optimus California and Texas as construction, with construction covering factory and infrastructure buildout and tool installation.
Tesla says progress on Optimus is ahead of mass production; this is a company production plan, not delivered units, customer availability, price or independent performance.
The same update covers Robotaxi and FSD; those are separate from the Optimus humanoid program and do not establish humanoid autonomy or safety certification.

companyFocus.name: Intuition Robotics
highlights: Intuition Robotics describes ElliQ as an AI care companion for older adults and reports 95% loneliness reduction, 90% health and wellness improvement and 79% social-connectedness improvement. These are company-reported outcomes, not independent clinical trials.
The Relationship Orchestrator combines multiple LLMs with context, memory, multimodality, goals, personalization and proactive interaction, according to the manufacturer.
The January 2024 announcement says ElliQ 3 has a lighter body, 36% smaller footprint, integrated screen and MediaTek octa-core plus AI SoC.
The company says the generative-AI software upgrade is compatible with all ElliQ hardware versions; ElliQ 3 hardware was expected in spring 2024.
ElliQ is supplied through a leased membership service; the reviewed pages publish no numeric price, mass, dimensions, battery runtime or independent safety/clinical certification.
companyFocus.reviewNotes: Batch152. Native Intuition Robotics company and January 2024 announcement pages read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. Company-reported outcomes, generative-AI capabilities, compatibility and leased membership are qualified; no independent clinical trial, numeric price, complete portfolio or universal USP is inferred.

companyFocus.name: Misty Robotics
highlights: Misty Robotics describes Misty II as a programmable social robot for education and research, with HTTP APIs, web sockets and block, Python and .NET tooling.
Manufacturer documentation lists a 35.56 × 25.4 × 20.32 cm body at 2.7 kg, Qualcomm Snapdragon 820 and 410 processors and an Occipital Structure Core depth sensor.
The robot has a 3-degree-of-freedom neck, moving arms, tracked drive, a trailer hitch, eight IR time-of-flight sensors, ten bump sensors and a 4-inch LCD.
The hazard system detects drops of 60 mm or more and limits speed to about 450 mm/s; the docs warn that edge detection can fail on rounded edges or when driving backwards.
USB/UART expansion and an optional Arduino-compatible backpack support external hardware. The reviewed pages publish no battery runtime, payload rating, IP rating or current availability.

source-integrity-check.inspection: Native HTML and one issuer PDF read as text only; no research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions.

body-scope-check.versionScopes: Tesla Optimus is the humanoid program represented by the April 2026 investor update; no separate generation is created. Misty II and ElliQ 3 are the named hardware generations; Misty software and ElliQ software versions are not collapsed into new robot models.
body-scope-check.priceScopes: No reviewed source publishes a numeric Optimus price. Misty II and ElliQ 3 prices are not established by the reviewed manufacturer text; ElliQ is supplied through a plan-dependent leased membership.
body-scope-check.weightScopes: Misty II body mass is 2.7 kg. Tesla Optimus and ElliQ 3 publish no mass in the reviewed text; “lighter” is comparative, not a mass value.
body-scope-check.sizeScopes: Misty II is 35.56 cm high, 25.4 cm deep and 20.32 cm wide. ElliQ 3 is described as having a 36% smaller footprint without dimensions. Optimus publishes no dimensions.
body-scope-check.payloadScopes: No numeric payload is published for Tesla Optimus. Misty’s trailer hitch can pull a payload but no rating is given. ElliQ has no payload role.
body-scope-check.speedScopes: Misty II maximum speed is about 450 mm/s, limited by the hazard system. Optimus and ElliQ publish no numeric speed.
body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: Tesla describes factory preparation and production targets, not delivered autonomous robots. Misty’s hazard system is a local safety behaviour with documented edge-detection limits. ElliQ’s proactive conversation and guardrails are manufacturer software descriptions, not independent clinical or safety certification.
body-scope-check.listingScopes: The buyandrentrobots listings and roboticsdir mentions identify products and families; they do not establish prices, current stock or delivered fleet counts.
